page-title.purpose: The single h1 on each page.

row-title.purpose: An event's name on the timeline.

data.purpose: Addresses, amounts and build hashes in Geist Mono.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: Plates are flat; depth is a hairline edge that brightens on hover.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Edge brightening on plates and the mark's orbit.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: The one thing a person can press on a row: buy, or watch the bidding.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #8b7cff; color: #0b0b0f; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8b7cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Event Plate
components.description: A translucent plate with a hairline edge that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; color: #f2f2f5; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-plate:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-time { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #9b9aa7; } .ds-plate h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

components.name: Tab Switch
components.description: Two views of one list, built as tabs.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-tabs button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #9b9aa7; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true] { background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); color: #f2f2f5; }

narrative.overview: HubWorld reads as a timetable: dates run down a left-hand rail, each event is a plate hung off that rail, and a small node on the rail says in one glance what state the night is in. Nothing is decorative that is not also information.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, translucent 4% plates, hairline edges that brighten on hover. No resting shadows.
One action colour (violet) and one state colour (green), never swapped.
Titles in tight 600-weight Geist; addresses, prices and times in Geist Mono or tabular figures.
State is always written down as well as coloured.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Violet means "you can act", green means "live". A thumbnail, a chip or a chart that happens to land in either hue is moved out of it.

rules.name: The Words Too Rule
rules.body: State is never carried by hue alone. A node is backed by a chip; a chip is backed by its label.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small tracked-capital label above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.

dos: Do keep violet for what can be pressed and green for what is live.
Do write state as a word as well as a colour.
Do let an edge brighten on hover instead of adding a shadow.
Do keep controls that cannot work absent, not disabled.
donts: Don't add a gradient to a surface, a headline word or a button on the app screens.
Don't put a decorative glow on anything but a live auction.
Don't put a kicker or tracked-capital label above a heading.
Don't let a fallback thumbnail or chip land in the greens.
